articles.summary: MORRISVILLE, Vt., Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Union Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ - UNB) today announced results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and declared a regular quarterly cash dividend. Consolidated net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $3.8 million, or $0.77 per share, compared to $3.4 million, or $0.75 per share, for the same period in 2025, and $9.7 million, or $2.03 per share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $8.3
articles.title: Union Bankshares Announces Earnings for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and Declares Quarterly Dividend
